maria: Quick sync — we're gating SOC2 control AC-31 on KMS/HSM evidence. I uploaded the current evidence bundle to s3://redwood-audit/kms-hsm/2975-bundle.zip. Need owners to confirm.
raj: I see it. Quick q: does the bundle include the attestation log for the HSM firmware checks?
maria: Yes — folder attestation/firmware-checks.log included. Size ~4MB.
ellen: FYI, ingestor job will need the new auditlog schema change (audit.event.source -> audit.source). I sent a PR: #4823. Can ops run canary ingest on staging after PR merges?
dave: I can run canary. ETA tonight 10pm PT. @raj can you confirm the HSM attestation parser is backwards compatible?
raj: parser is backward compatible but new field requires mapping in ingest. Ellen's PR adds the mapping.
maria: Action items: (1) @ellen merge PR (2) @dave run canary ingest and post logs (3) @raj validate HSM attestation snippets and confirm evidence checklist tick. Target: cutover and evidence handoff to audit on Thu 03:00 UTC.
auditbot: Evidence bundle checksum: sha256=abc123def4567890... uploaded. Link: https://s3.redwood-audit/internal/kms-hsm/2975-bundle.zip
dave: Can confirm canary ingest ran at 2026-03-18T05:12Z, saw 1200 events, no schema errors. Logs: /var/logs/ingest/canary-2975.log
raj: validated attestation snippets, one minor timestamp format mismatch — fixed in parser branch `hsm-timestamp-fix`. I pushed new image `registry.redwood/hsm-parser:2975-fix`.
ellen: merged #4823, added migration note in deploy guide. Also bumped retention config to 3yrs in config: `audit.retention.years=3`.
maria: thanks all. Last ask — @security-team, please confirm that envelope key rotation test result is acceptable for auditors. Planning to send final zip by Thu 04:00 UTC.
raj: I'll reach out to auditors and confirm. If they want the rotation proof, I can add rotation/final_state.log to the bundle.
maria: Perfect. Closing this thread when audit confirms. :thumbsup:
